value.rationale: PASS: A natural complete classification of which shifted suffixes of a nontrivial rank-one binary morphic fixed point admit each substitution-power pure Abelian period, with exact digital census for all shifts. This is a structural quantifier-sensitive result, not a routine factor-count table.

final_claim: For φ(0)=0^a1^b, φ(1)=1^b0^a with a,b≥1, a nonaligned shift c=qL+r (L=a+b) has L^t as a pure Abelian period iff one of the lowest t−1 base-L digits of q is in {min(a,b),...,max(a,b)−1}; exactly L^t−(L−1)(2min(a,b))^(t−1) of the first L^t shifts have that period. All aligned-shift periods are exactly positive multiples of L.
limitations: Nonaligned periods other than powers of L are not classified.
Finite 2436-case test is corroboration, not proof; possible uninspected primary full text covering shifts.
